type.help: The provider type of the model. This determines which model implementation to use. Supported types are OLLAMA, OPEN_AI_COMPATIBLE, and GEMINI.

model.help: The identifier of the specific model to use. For example, 'gemini-1.5-flash-latest' for Gemini, or 'llama2' for Ollama.

temperature.help: Controls the creativity and randomness of the model's responses. A higher temperature (e.g., 1.0) results in more varied and unexpected outputs, while a lower temperature (e.g., 0.2) makes the output more deterministic and focused.

maxContextLength.help: The maximum number of tokens the model can consider as context for generating a response. Exceeding this limit will result in older messages being truncated.

numPredict.help: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the model's response. This helps control the length of the output.

topK.help: Filters the vocabulary to consider only the top K most probable tokens for the next word. A smaller K makes the output more focused, while a larger K allows for more diversity.

topP.help: Filters the vocabulary to consider tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds P. This allows for dynamic selection of tokens, preventing the model from getting stuck in repetitive loops or generating irrelevant content.

repeatPenalty.help: Reduces the likelihood of the model repeating the same phrases or tokens. Higher values increase the penalty, leading to more diverse output.

stopTokens.help: A list of strings that, if generated by the model, will cause the generation to stop. Useful for ensuring the model doesn't continue past a certain point or for specific formatting needs.

responseFormat.help: Specifies the desired format of the model's response, such as 'json' for structured output. Not all models support all response formats.

toolCallingEnabled.help: If true, enables the model to call external tools or functions. This requires the model to support tool calling.

toolCallingSupported.help: Indicates whether the underlying model provider infrastructure supports tool calling. This is a read-only property reflecting the model's capabilities.

apiKey.description: Required API key for GEMINI models.
apiKey.help: The API key is mandatory when using Google Gemini models.

apiKey.description: API key for OpenAI compatible models (optional for local servers).
apiKey.help: The API key for OpenAI compatible models. This can be optional if you are running a local server that does not require authentication.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for OpenAI compatible models (required if using remote API).
baseUrl.help: The base URL for OpenAI compatible models. This is typically required when an apiKey is present for remote services.

serverCommand.description: Command to start local OpenAI compatible model server.
serverCommand.help: The command to execute the local server for OpenAI compatible models. Only applicable if you are hosting the model locally.

serverArgs.description: Arguments for local OpenAI compatible model server.
serverArgs.help: Arguments to be passed to the local OpenAI compatible model server. Relevant when 'serverCommand' is used.

serverWorkdir.description: Working directory for local OpenAI compatible model server.
serverWorkdir.help: The directory where the local OpenAI compatible model server should be executed from.

baseUrl.description: Ollama API base URL (defaults to http://localhost:11434).
baseUrl.help: The base URL for the Ollama API. Defaults to the standard local Ollama address.
